target_definitions.coordinate_normalization: u/image_width and v/image_height; projected EE remains floating and unclipped

target_definitions.invisible_object_rule: visibility=0; area and mask metrics remain defined; centroid and relative targets are invalid and never imputed
target_definitions.ee_image_displacement: L2 norm of candidate-pair projected EE coordinate difference
target_definitions.object_centroid_displacement: maximum normalized image centroid displacement among objects visible in both candidates
target_definitions.object_mask_difference: maximum full-image symmetric-difference fraction among per-object natural semantic masks; object-wise 1-IoU retained diagnostically
target_definitions.relative_image_displacement: maximum norm of pair difference in (object centroid - projected EE)
target_definitions.ee_object_distance_change: maximum absolute change in object-centroid to projected-EE distance
target_definitions.strict_proximity_change: maximum absolute change in projected-EE to natural object-mask distance divided by image diagonal
target_definitions.robot_object_adjacency_change: maximum absolute change in fraction of object-boundary pixels within frozen square dilation radius of natural robot mask
